name: Gasthaus-Appartement Wildauer
beschreibung: The Gasthaus-Appartement Wildauer in Ebbs is a traditionally run inn. Situated in the Tyrolean Lower Inn Valley, it is only a short distance from the historic town of Kufstein. The landscape is shaped by the foothills of the Kaisergebirge mountains, making it ideal for walking, hiking, and cycling tours. The inn provides both quality restaurant dining and comfortable apartments with a separate living area. Each apartment comes equipped with a kitchenette and essential amenities. Complimentary Wi-Fi and parking are provided for guests. The property combines a quiet, peaceful setting with excellent road connections, making it a very popular home base for exploring the region.
